headline: The Original iPhone Had No Copy-Paste for Two Full Years

slides.speaker: vj

slides.speaker: vr
slides.title: Why Apple Skipped It 🤔

slides.speaker: vj
slides.title: Gesture Focus 🖐️

takeaway: Imagine a world without copy-paste! The original iPhone, a revolution in many ways, surprisingly lacked this basic feature for its first two years, prioritizing groundbreaking touch gestures instead.
caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

The original iPhone, a device that changed the world, launched without one of the most basic features we use every day: Copy and Paste!

Here's why this mind-blowing fact is true:
🔹 Launched in 2007, the iPhone prioritized innovative multi-touch gestures.
🔹 Apple wanted to ensure a 'perfect' copy-paste experience with gestures, taking time.
🔹 The feature finally arrived two years later in 2009 with iPhone OS 3.0!
